$comment: PROVISIONAL SPEC, not yet produced by any code. #506 commit 7 (the "meedya-convert settings" command) has not been written yet; this file defines the shape it must produce, worked out from the plan (.claude/plans/settings-export-import-plan.md, section 6) and from the engine's SettingsExport, SettingsImportPreview and SettingsImportResult types. If commit 7 finds this shape does not fit once it is actually being built, THIS FILE is what changes, together with SettingsCLIReportSchema.generate() and SettingsSchemaTests — never a silent mismatch between what the CLI prints and what this schema describes.

added.description: Import only: how many items this group adds.

category.description: The group's internal name, exactly as SettingsCategory and the settings file itself use it.

count.description: How many settings, or profiles, the file has for this group.

removed.description: Import, replace mode only: how many of this Mac's items this group removes.

selected.description: Whether this group was ticked (chosen with --categories, or the default).

summary.description: One plain-English sentence summarising this group, the same wording the text report and the app's preview use.

updated.description: Import only: how many items this group changes.

ignoredItem.description: Something in the imported file that was not imported. Never fatal: the rest of the file still imports (SettingsIgnoredItem).

belongsIn.description: Only present when reason is "wrongGroup": the group the setting actually belongs in.

explanation.description: One plain sentence saying what was ignored and why (SettingsIgnoredItem.explanation).

group.description: The group name as written in the file, when the ignored item was inside one. Absent for a problem with the file's top level.

name.description: The setting, group or field name, exactly as written in the file.

stillNeededItem.description: A password, key, key file or consent that still needs entering on this Mac (SettingsCredentialNeed).

explanation.description: Why it was not copied, when worth saying.

status.description: Whether it is definitely missing, or this Mac could not check.

statusReason.description: Only present when status is "couldNotCheck": why it could not be checked. Never implies the item is actually missing.

title.description: What it is (“TMDB key”, “SFTP server ‘NAS’ password”).

description: The “--format json” output of “meedya-convert settings export” and “meedya-convert settings import” (issue #506).

appVersion.description: The version of MeedyaConverter running the command.

applied.description: Import only: true once --apply has written the change; false for a preview (the default — see the plan's owner decision 2).

categories.description: One entry per settings group the command touched, in the usual order (General, Encoding, Your encoding profiles, Connections, This Mac only).

crossChecks.description: Import only: statements about things that will not work exactly as the other Mac had them (for example, a default profile this Mac does not have).

file.description: The settings file path that was read (import) or written (export).

ignored.description: Import only: things in the file that were not imported, and why.

leftOut.description: Export only: the names of things set up on this Mac that the file never carries.

mode.description: Import only: how the file was, or would be, combined with this Mac's settings.

replaceConfirmation.description: Import, replace mode only: one sentence naming what Replace removes.

stillNeeded.description: Import only, after applying: passwords, keys and consents that still need entering on this Mac.

takesEffectNextLaunch.description: Import only, after applying: plain-English labels of settings that only take effect the next time MeedyaConverter opens.

warnings.description: Cautions for risky settings selected for import (for example, a switched-on “delete source after encode”).
